messages:
lena_cs: Quick sync for Pelorus onboarding - main items we must finalize: who holds KMS admin, how audit logs are routed to their SIEM, and confirmation of egress posture. Need decisions this week to unblock provisioning.

lena_cs: TL;DR: customer wants admin separation (they keep key admin), but Redwood needs Decrypt/Encrypt and Rotate permissions for runtime. Also they want events in Splunk + an internal read-only logs bucket for RBAC.

omar_se: For the runtime we only need kms:Decrypt on the CMK for node role and kms:Encrypt for results. We should NOT grant ScheduleKeyDeletion to their admin role. We can add a condition for aws:PrincipalAccount to limit who can perform destructive actions.

nina_compliance: Pelorus compliance wants key rotation policy audited and rotation triggered by their KMS admin. They will accept Redwood performing CreateGrant/RetireGrant for short-term access if we use a grant-based pattern. Also require CloudTrail data events for S3 and KMS.

cal_platform: Grant-based flow sounds good. Implementation note: if we create a CMK in their account (recommended), their security team retains admin. Redwood will assume a cross-account role to call kms:Decrypt via grants we create dynamically. That keeps rotation/admin with Pelorus.

kevin_ops: Audit pipeline: prefer Firehose -> Splunk HEC. Need HEC endpoint + token (we asked for token via 1Password). Also we need an agreed retention: they asked 180d hot, 365d total before archiving. Can we support that?

lena_cs: They pushed back to 90d hot, 365d archival. I'll confirm tonight.

omar_se: Networking follow-up: customer will force egress through their proxy. We must ensure CA pinning for TLS-inspection. If they supply CA certs, Redwood can pin intermediate cert for outbound connections. Any issues with using pinned CA in our sidecar proxy?

nina_compliance: CA pinning is acceptable. Ensure we have an expiration/rotation plan for pinned CA (they requested 30d notice for cert swaps). Add that to runbook.

cal_platform: Action items I will take: create terraform module for cross-account role + grant workflow, and a sample KMS key policy template that denies ScheduleKeyDeletion except to our SRE admin. Deliver by Thursday.

kevin_ops: I'll prototype the Firehose -> Splunk pipeline and post sample event flow. Need bucket naming convention approved: pelorus-redwood-audit-usw2? Any objections?

lena_cs: That name works. Add tags: project=pelorus, env=prod.

deploy-bot: Infra checklist: no PRs detected for pelorus infra. Waiting on cal_platform TF module and omar_se SG changes.

omar_se: Small blocker: customer's security team requires SSH bastion to be disabled for the inference hosts. They want all access via SSM Session Manager. We need to ensure SSM IAM role has kms:Decrypt for session logs if logs are encrypted.

cal_platform: Noted. We'll include ssm:StartSession in the cross-account role and ensure session logs write to the encrypted bucket using the CMK. That requires kms:GenerateDataKey permissions for the role that writes logs.

nina_compliance: Also need CloudTrail configured to log management and data events to the dedicated audit bucket and CloudWatch for alarms. Add an alert for any CreateKey or ScheduleKeyDeletion attempts.

kevin_ops: Draft lifecycle policy for audit bucket (as discussed):
```
{
  "Rules": [
    { "ID": "hot-to-glacier", "Status": "Enabled", "Transitions": [{"Days":90, "StorageClass":"GLACIER"}], "Expiration": {"Days":730} }
  ]
}
```
We can tweak days after Pelorus confirms.

lena_cs: Renewal risk: Pelorus CSM says current blocker is KMS admin separation + proof of audited key usage. If we deliver the grant-based model + test logs to Splunk by Friday, CS thinks renewal discussion will proceed positively.

omar_se: I'll deliver SG and proxy config by Wednesday EOD.

cal_platform: TF module + policy by Thursday.

kevin_ops: Firehose smoke test scheduled Friday 10am PT (after TF applied).

nina_compliance: I'll run a compliance checklist review on Friday afternoon and send any gaps.

lena_cs: OK team, please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your item. I'll host a 20min sync Friday 11am PT to review logs + demo. Ping me if anything blocks before then. :rocket:
